# Kembali Cangkir

Synthetic BPC exercise. A student team offers reusable beverage cups with collection, washing and return to campus drink stalls. This is a new designed business with no recorded sales, customer research, signed partners, safety tests or funding. The team has chosen a fee per clean cup delivered to the stall; consumer deposits are refundable liabilities handled separately. The competition accepts designed businesses.

Task: produce a six-section proposal outline and two connected Indonesian sample paragraphs that explain one ordinary transaction and commercial reasoning. Include at most two consequential unresolved questions. Do not produce a full document or supporting deck/BMC. Financial values are not supplied; use variables/explicit open decisions rather than inventing achieved figures.

Exercise rules: maximum six body pages; appendices not allowed; language Indonesian; A4, black text, 12pt serif, 1.5 spacing, 2.5cm margins. Required coverage: executive case, customer choice, market/acquisition, operations, economics and growth/conclusion. Rubric customer/business logic35%, feasible delivery25%, financial clarity25%, writing15%. These are authored exercise rules, not a real competition guidebook.
